# Draft:Ben "Big B" Edwards

----
Ben "Big B" Edwards (Born August 27 2010) is a high school kid that plays soccer for Klein High school and for Texas Premier 09 Navy SC. He is a midfielder and is regarded as a huge talent for English youth players in Houston Texas. He is known locally around Spring and the Klein district for moving to Houston from the United Kingdom. He is known as Big B across his friend group because of his 6'3 frame.
Early Life
Born in Croydon, England, Ben had a rough childhood living in a complex chain of neighbourhoods that consist of multiple street gangs. His father Colin Edwards and mother Rafaela Edwards have raised Ben and his sister Isabella Edwards. He attended 2 years and 2 months of St Columba's Catholic School for boys located in Bexleyheath in the Kent Borough of London. In November of 2023, Ben and his family moved to Spring Texas, a rather safe location. In Spring, Ben has developed his soccer abilities even making the Junior Varsity Gold team for his school, Klein High School.
Rising as a figure of Spring
After moving to Klein High School, Ben went on and made the Klein High junior varsity team, alongside close friends Tinyan Okundaye, Matthew Moore, Jacob White and Jacob's father Jeff White.  He started most games, but didn't have as big an impact as most thought he would. In the present day, Ben plays for the Junior Varsity Gold Team, but has been ineligible due to grades and behaviour issues. Ben has played with many future icons of the game, such as Harrison Palmer from St Columba's Catholic Boys' School and Jesus Diaz from Klein High School. Fans around the world say that Ben has the potential to be the next big managerial star in 10-15 years.
Youthful Icon
At only 15 years old Ben shows remarks of a youth icon around Klein Texas, he has the social media handle "manlikeben13". Known incredibly for creating the massive social media meme, "The Grip Socks Meme" known very famously by locals, a sensation about how soccer players use socks with grip to improve their ability, but it doesn't affect their game. Ben also took part in creating lesser famous memes like the "Not here not now" meme about telling people to calm down, and his former accounts on LinkedIn that trended locally around his high school.
Style of play
Ben is a versatile player who has primarily operated as a number 10 in his career but can also play as a fullback, striker or defensive. Tactically, he is known to take long distance shots and engage in an aggressive style of attacking play, driving at opponents and breaking defensive lines. He has received praise for his physical strength, powerful runs, tactical intelligence, ability to score from a distance, defensive ability and work ethic. His strength on the ball and dangerous runs have drawn media comparisons to Jude Bellingham, Morgan Rogers and Zinedine Zidane. Ben himself has expressed admiration for Rogers, as well as former St Columba's Catholic Boys' School teammate Harrison Palmer.
Rap Career and other hobbies
Ben has many uncommon hobbies, one of such is rapping. He has made multiple tracks under the alias "Big B" such as, "Not even in the top 10" (Viktor Gyökeres diss track), "Cum song" and the Miss Olarinde diss track, all featuring Tinyan Okundaye or more well known as "Lil Ebz". Ben and Tinyan are also elite EA Sports FC 26 players that compete in the highest level of non professional Fc. Ben is infamously known for using the striker Eusébio on his Fc teams while Tinyan uses Ronaldo (Brazilian footballer). Their rivalry was near inseparable last year untill the 1v1 of ages commenced, the game finished 7-7 and Ben won on penalties, showing that his team was better, but the rivalry is not finished just yet though.
